title: BATWA v2.4.13 Official Release
message: Naya update live ho chuka hai! ABHI Microfinance Bank official branding & 1Link transfer, updated bank logos, active 24/7 Cloudflare Gateway, aur enhanced cards navigation shamil hain.
features: Official HD ABHI Microfinance Bank integration with 1Link / Raast title fetch
Verified bank branding: ABHI, ABL, Al Baraka, Soneri, BOK, DIB, Raqami, aik, Samba
High-speed 24/7 Cloudflare Gateway connection to live Supabase backend
Dynamic 1Bill inquiry & fixed payment receipts with strict length validation
Official HD Telecom logos for Jazz, Ufone, and Zong (Telenor removed)
Direct Cards tab navigation to virtual cards screen without popups
Compact analytics overview cards and clean dark green category breakdown bullets
Complete purge of pig/piggy bank icons and terms across the entire app
changelog: Added ABHI Microfinance Bank with official 512x512 branding and 1Link transfer support
Configured dedicated high-speed Cloudflare Gateway with instant auth/ping clearance
Integrated 1Link title fetch in Bank Transfer eliminating manual receiver name typing
Updated bank & telco logos to authentic verified PNGs
Direct Cards tab navigation and streamlined analytics dashboard
